name: Supabase Auth
subtitle: Open-source auth in the Supabase platform
creator: Supabase (Paul Copplestone and Ant Wilson)
license: Open source (server is a GoTrue fork)
description: Sign-up and sign-in with email and password, magic links, one-time codes, phone, 20+ OAuth providers, SAML SSO, MFA and anonymous users. Users live in your project's Postgres, and the JWTs it issues are read by Row Level Security policies through auth.uid().

languages.youWrite: JavaScript or TypeScript, Dart, Swift, Kotlin or Python, plus SQL policies

concepts.explanation: createClient() gives you auth and data access.
Users stored in your own Postgres.
Policies use auth.uid() to scope data.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript

pros: Auth and data permissions in one place via RLS
Users live in your own Postgres
cons: RLS policies are easy to get wrong
Fewer enterprise features than Auth0 or Keycloak

pricing.summary: Free: 50,000 monthly active users. Pro from $25/mo with 100,000 MAU included, then $0.00325 per MAU. Team from $599/mo.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
